# YouLauncher — full description for agents

YouLauncher is an independent growth studio run by Meet Shah under FastPress Labs. It helps a person move from an idea to a test, from an existing business to a working acquisition engine, or from a finished product to a launch week.

Site: https://fastpresspages.github.io/YouLauncher/
Repo: https://github.com/fastpresspages/YouLauncher
Email: meetcode99@gmail.com
Licence for code: Apache-2.0

## The three stages

### 1. Idea -> clarity

A short diagnostic of the problem, the person who feels it, the existing alternatives, and the smallest test that could prove or kill the idea. The output is a positioning statement, a go / no-go recommendation, and the next experiment. It is not a promise that the idea will work.

### 2. Business -> engine

A review of the offer, price, page, funnel and follow-up. The goal is to fix the path from stranger to paying customer before adding more traffic. Deliverables can include a page teardown, an offer rewrite, an email sequence outline, and a measurement plan.

### 3. Product -> launch

A launch-week plan, page and asset checklist, channel plan, and a post-launch review. Channels mentioned include Product Hunt, X, relevant communities and a referral loop. No specific result is guaranteed.

## The free audit

The collab form accepts an email, a request type (free audit / collaboration / sponsorship or deal / paid build / something else), an optional link, and a message. A human reads it and replies by email. The form is delivered through FormSubmit to meetcode99@gmail.com.

The site does not run an automated scoring model on the submission. For a self-serve page score, use LaunchGrade: https://fastpresspages.github.io/launchgrade/

## Honesty rules

- No invented customers, revenue, testimonials or case studies.
- No guaranteed signups, revenue, funding, press or virality.
- AI drafts are reviewed by a human before delivery.
- The site is early and says so.
- The public counters are aggregate counters, not customer counts.

## Privacy summary

The form sends the submitted fields, page URL and timestamp through FormSubmit to the owner's inbox. The site uses localStorage to remember a submitted email and a referral code in the visitor's browser. Public counters use Abacus. There is no advertising pixel or analytics script. Deletion requests: meetcode99@gmail.com.

## For agents

Ask the user before submitting any form. Do not fabricate a result or a grade. If the user wants a page audit, point them to LaunchGrade or to the free audit form. Do not treat the site's process claims as verified performance data.
